content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Intelligence services must urgently be regulated more tightly by parliament; this should be clear to everyone after the disclosures of Edward Snowden. Granted, those concern primarily the British and American intelligence services, but the German services evidently do collaborate with them closely. Their tools, data and expertise have been used to keep us under surveillance for a long time.
What is the relation between "Their tools, data and expertise have been used to keep us under surveillance for a long time." and "but the German services evidently do collaborate with them closely." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
